task.description: Validate src/design/iss0618-scheduler-lock-and-error-signaling.md, a Type E design fixing GH #567 / ISS-0618's two scheduler bugs. Fix 1 (TC-SCH-02-02): when the FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED query returns 0 rows, issue a second lock-agnostic existence query (same WHERE/ORDER BY, no FOR UPDATE) -- zero rows there means genuinely .none, one or more rows means .skipped_locked. Fix 2 (TC-SCH-02-03): only the appendTimerFiredEventInTx call site inside fire_blk changes -- on failure, still roll back and still call handleTimerFireError (preserving ISS-303's retry bookkeeping), then return SchedulerError.TransactionFailed directly instead of falling through to false/.none. Every other fire_blk step keeps its existing catch-and-swallow behavior. CODE-DESIGNER's claim: this doesn't conflict with ISS-303's own test suite (tests/integration/sch303_timer_dlq_test.zig, specifically TC-SCH-303-03/04, which trigger the SAME duplicate-idempotency-key failure) because those tests discard pollDueTimers's return value via catch {} in a polling loop and only depend on handleTimerFireError's side effects (retry count, DLQ entry), never on the return value being error-free. VERIFY THIS CLAIM YOURSELF against actual source -- read tests/integration/sch303_timer_dlq_test.zig's TC-SCH-303-03 and TC-SCH-303-04 blocks and confirm they genuinely discard/ignore pollDueTimers's return value rather than asserting on it. If they DO assert on the return value being .none or similar, this design would break them, which would be a genuine regression this handoff exists to catch before implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Fix 1 design verified correct against actual query structure in scheduler.zig
Fix 2 design verified correct -- only the specified call site changes, others unchanged
CRITICAL: the claim that TC-SCH-303-03/04 discard pollDueTimers return value is independently verified against actual source, not trusted
No other production code paths inadvertently affected

result.summary: Validated src/design/iss0618-scheduler-lock-and-error-signaling.md against src/scheduler/scheduler.zig, tests/integration/sch02_timer_polling_test.zig, and tests/integration/sch303_timer_dlq_test.zig. Fix 1 (lock-agnostic existence re-check on zero-row SKIP LOCKED result) and Fix 2 (appendTimerFiredEventInTx call site returns SchedulerError.TransactionFailed directly, after rollback + handleTimerFireError, instead of falling through to fire_blk's false/.none) both match the actual source structure at the line ranges the design cites (query 189-215, fire_blk 309-398, call site at line 338, handleTimerFireError signature at 555-562). CRITICAL claim independently verified: TC-SCH-303-03 (line 181) and TC-SCH-303-04 (line 291) both call `_ = scheduler.pollDueTimers(allocator) catch {};` inside their retry loops, discarding the return value entirely, and their assertions afterward query only timers.status/fire_error_count/failed_at and dead_letter_items -- never the return value of pollDueTimers. The design's claim that these tests are unaffected by Fix 2 is correct. No other fire_blk call site is touched by the design. lint_design_artefact.py exits 0 (BLOCKER=0, MAJOR=0, MINOR=1 -- pre-existing ISS-0618 filename/ID format mismatch with <PREFIX>-<NN> pattern, not a design defect).
